title: Wang source reconstruction readiness is limited to 11 unique target-anchor matches
claim: The accepted Product #545 reconstruction probe evaluates 37 source-bounded candidate inputs across 24 Wang cases and reports 11 unique target-anchor matches, 6 multiple matches, 5 no matches, 2 source-incomplete cases and 0 engine-unsupported candidates. Only the 11 unique matches are eligible for a later full-chart materialization step; this does not mean those full charts are already materialized or validated against every source annotation.
maturity_note: The accepted source reconstruction readiness and acceptance artifacts record the bounded probe outcome; PR #554 merged into main at commit 81fca. CONTRACT_PASS is limited to the pinned candidate-input/target-anchor readiness contract, not full-chart equivalence or expert replay.
wording_ceiling: Say '11 of 24 cases are eligible for later full-chart materialization under a source-bounded target-anchor gate; 13 remain withheld.' Do not say 11 full charts are already fully verified, or that expert replay/predictive validity is established.

limitations: Only source-printed lunar inputs and explicitly bounded alternatives are permitted; no OCR guesses, biography backfills or reverse-solving.

The target anchor checks palace identity and fourteen-major-star structure (or source-explicit opposite borrowing), not all auxiliary stars, transformations, annotations or full source-chart equivalence.
The next Product work unit is full-chart materialization; this record does not claim that step is complete.
Six cases remain ambiguous, five do not match the anchor and two lack sufficient source input.
Full expert replay, method fidelity, empirical probability and predictive validity remain separate and unestablished.
